posts.author: dark_chaki277
posts.body:
About the project:
I have recently created project (
RPG Maker MV
) with some custom sprites, some custom scripts, and some work already made to create the game menu. The game is called "Mushroom story". The game genre is a classic old school rpg about a family reunion, honor and self-sacrifice.
Story line:
A young family of mushrooms where murdered by some evil mushroom pickers. Unluckily for the pickers, meteorite fell nearby the scene. The mushroom survivors mutated and are hungry for vengeance.
Looking for:
I m looking for co-creators which are ready to help for free and ready to perform tasks from different fields. You can gain some experience from the project, apply your dormant potential. I need one or two people, cause I want to contribute to the game mainly as a script writer, event writer, plugin manager. I hope to find two guys: one should be mapper/sprite creator and another one musician/scripter/writer.
Expectations:
I expect that we can create a decent demo. If we come to this stage, we ll decide what to do next.
